$comment: Reviewed exceptions to scripts/forbidden-claims.json, in ADR 0034 Decision 10's own field shape (id/rule/text/scope/justification/evidence/approver/issued/expires) -- AAASM-5796 correction: the first version of this file (AAASM-5796, PR #109) invented a 7-field ad-hoc schema instead of reading claim-vocabulary.md and ADR 0034 first, which name AAASM-5599 -- this checker -- as the reader of the ONE canonical waiver scheme. `rule` here is `<class>/<locale>` from forbidden-claims.json, since this checker's rule shape is a phrase catalogue, not ADR 0034 2.1's D-dimension tuple; claim-vocabulary.md 7.1 licenses each caller to state what a field means for its own rule shape without adding a field or a location. Interim location: this repo has no TRUTH-ADOPTION.md yet (that rollout is AAASM-5601's, not this ticket's), so exceptions live here under the same key name (`exceptions`) the ADR uses, so moving them into TRUTH-ADOPTION.md's front matter later is a relocation, not a redesign. class 'fd-7' (or any rule resolving to it) can never appear here: the 14 ADR 0033 forbidden-design-7 absolutes are unwaivable by anyone, for any period (ADR 0034 Decision 10, category 2 of the four things that may never be waived).
